rule: LOGS is the consolidated runtime evidence folder, while lane-level logs may remain inside their execution lanes.

membranes.DATA/MEMORY/ROUTES: route meaning, state ledgers, and system interpretation

law: Do not mingle source, runtime proof, receipts, anchors, and route ledgers.
Root LOGS is consolidated runtime evidence.
Lane LOGS may exist when the lane produces its own process logs.
Do not store private keys, raw tokens, cert contents, API secrets, or raw credentials in LOGS.
Do not paste token-bearing process output into public records.
